playback: All recorded rollouts are overlaid, each normalized by its own recorded duration. This is display alignment, not measured concurrency or a wall-clock comparison.
heat: Distinct rollouts per 1 m cell; 8 four-neighbor diffusion steps, weight 0.2, no flux across walls; fixed global normalization and gamma 0.72.
coverage: Recomputed from full-precision, positive-interval samples on the original eligible 2 m grid; heat smoothing does not change coverage.
